notes: three taḥwīl branches (before the last «ح» and after it) all meet at «شعبة», so the tail is shared; «قالوا جميعا» joins Abd al-Rahman and Bahz at one level; «وفي رواية بهز» names Abu Sa'id as the source Anas gave (the remark's «له» is not written by name): a variant group, not a route; «غير أن في حديثهم» is wording, left out
